scope.text: Auth, Host/Origin and sandbox Host checks use the matched route (request.routeOptions.url), closing the encoded-path bypass (8a07e21).
A widget modal survives a board reload with an equal source; a save conflict keeps edit mode and edits (9649e9d, 96e226b).
Rejected gateway calls and wrong confirmation ids spend the rate limit; RATE_LIMITED writes no audit row; hourly audit purge and index on at (119b4d9, 91c095f, 746beec).
Three user declines block a widget for 5 minutes; confirmations, toasts and modals identify the package (0a8e4d5, 99748d9, bf44916).
Plain text and space titles reject blank and hidden control text, keeping ZWJ/ZWNJ (393f50b).
API exits on stdin EOF when LIFEDASHBOARD_EXIT_ON_STDIN_EOF=1; desktop pipes stdin, sets the variable and shows early start errors (2fa9736, da2dd4a, bf44916).

SDK build skips dotfiles in assets; modal options accept undefined; non-Latin-1 headers rejected; new manifests need canonical versions; create-widget names the slug reason (053519c, fe19311, 121e773, 5313c67).
Approved host names resolving to private addresses are refused at connect time via an undici Agent lookup; literal IPs and localhost stay allowed (9f93a38).
Dead helpers removed and theme contract wording fixed (ddf2c80).
